summary: Settle takes a finished chat out of the desktop sidebar's "Done recently" group without archiving it: the chat keeps its project, history and row in the workspace tree. A Done row shows a Settle button where its time sits (on row hover, on focus within the row, and always without hover); focus moves to the next row, or the previous one. The sidebar footer shows "Settled <title>" with Undo and a Cmd+Z keycap for 8 s, and a polite live region says "Settled <title>. Press Cmd+Z to undo." Cmd+Z (Ctrl+Z off a Mac) undoes it while focus is not in a text field, the composer or a terminal. A chat stays settled until it has newer activity (its list activity time passes settled_at), so a new turn brings it back with no extra write. When a linked pull request changes to merged and the chat is idle (no turn running, no card open, no error), the backend settles it once per change and the notice reads "Settled <title>: PR #n merged". Phones hide a settled chat from Home > Recents while it is Done or idle and offer no settle action in this release.
